contradictions.description: EntityDescription_FindAndWritePropertyByName compares two StdStringMSVC fields within the same 0x110-byte DataDescription element: element+0x24 against element+0x40. This suggests the parse-time DataDescription stores TWO name fields — likely a short name and a full/qualified name. The comparison finds elements where both names match the search key. This contradicts a simple single-name model. The DataDescription +0x04 StdStringMSVC from DataDescription_Constructor may be the client name and +0x24 the full name.

EntityDescription_FindMethodIdByName takes a ushort key parameter but calls FUN_00437890 to do the actual map find. The parameter appears to be a hash or encoded key, not a raw string pointer. This is distinct from EntityDescription name-based lookup — the uint16 encoding matches the multi-byte method ID scheme from MethodDescription_ComputeIdBase (0x01590bb0). Confidence: MEDIUM — caller context needed.
